objective: Test whether prior completed US technology/semiconductor sessions contain stable point-in-time information for executable future returns of core A-share technology ETFs beyond local momentum, and only if that passes, beyond validated ETF share-flow evidence.
entry_rule: For A-share trading date D, external data may use only the latest fully completed US cash session whose close occurred before the A-share open on D. Return labels start at the A-share open on D.
point_in_time_rule: No US session completing after the A-share open may be used. Local momentum uses closes no later than D-1. If Stage B is reached, ETF share facts for trading day T are usable only from T+1 A-share trading day.
method_note: The GitHub lead-lag project is methodological inspiration only. This PoC independently implements simple point-in-time lag alignment and partial Spearman diagnostics; no upstream code is copied into production.
